Is a damaged item handled differently from a normal return?
Yes, a damaged item is handled differently from a standard return.
For shipping damage or manufacturing defects, we cover the shipping cost to send you a replacement at no extra charge, or issue a full refund if a replacement isn't possible. Standard returns, on the other hand, require you to cover all freight costs and may carry a restocking fee (such as a 50% restocking fee for orders over $1,000 or a $500 fee for orders under $1,000).
Both require contacting us within two business days of delivery to receive a Return Authorization Number (RA#) before returning any items.
